text: Free co-op shooter demo where the food fights back.
Killer tacos, rabid salads, and a burger boss with teeth.
You're a mutated food court chef with ridiculous kitchen weapons, and up to three friends.
It plays fast. Strafe, jump, blast, and hits pop comic-book words on screen.
Between fights, there's platforming over pits of green goo.
The catch? The menus look like placeholders next to all that colour.
The demo is over seven gigs on your drive, English only.
Think Borderlands colours in a Roboquest-style run.
Worth a dip with friends and an empty stomach.
